proofs.text: Run the command with `--help`, with `--nope` and with no argument; verify the exit codes are 0, 2 and 2
Run the command for the feature `nothing`, which no spec declares; verify it exits 1
Run `brief.py` as a command in a separate process against a recorded project; verify it exits 0 and its output carries a `Verdict:` line

tests.body:
def test_help_exits_zero_and_a_bad_option_exits_two(self):
        assert brief_module.main(['--help']) == 0
        assert brief_module.main(['--nope']) == 2
        assert brief_module.main([]) == 2
tests.name: test_help_exits_zero_and_a_bad_option_exits_two

tests.body:
def test_an_unknown_feature_exits_one(self, proved, capsys):
        code = brief_module.main(['--feature', 'nothing',
                                  '--project-root', proved.root])
        capsys.readouterr()
        assert code == 1
tests.name: test_an_unknown_feature_exits_one

tests.body:
def test_the_script_runs_as_a_command(self, proved):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, BRIEF_PY, '--feature', 'login', '--rule',
             'RULE-1', '--project-root', proved.root],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr
        assert 'Verdict:' in result.stdout
tests.name: test_the_script_runs_as_a_command
